openings.claim: Speculatively, unresolved labels may be unable to change the verdict. Replace completed-adjudication counts with worst-case certificates: carry paired candidate-minus-baseline correctness intervals in slice-grouped confusion tables; unresolved differing predictions contribute [-1,+1], agreeing predictions zero. Select an accessible flagged row whose possible adjudication most reduces uncertainty at a threatened acceptance boundary, breaking ties deterministically by record ID.
openings.discriminator: Nearest rival: adjudicate sixteen highest-disagreement rows before ordinary counts. Certificates may require fewer adjudications when disagreements concentrate on prediction agreements or harmless margins; when disagreements coincide with decisive rows, the rival may match or outperform. Compare adjudications to a supported verdict, unresolved frequency, and agreement with the sealed decision key.
openings.probe: Use only supplied records/labels with reproducible paired calculations. Run both workflows on matched copies within seventy minutes and independently reset sixteen-row allowances; preselect the same four withheld rows. Log selections, reasons, results, unsuccessful accesses and elapsed time; unsuccessful access consumes no allowance. Advance only if total lower bound >=4 and every slice lower bound >=-2. Reject only if total upper bound <4 or any slice upper bound <-2. Otherwise continue or report unresolved at capacity. Freeze both reports before opening the full-label key.
openings.uncertainty: Actual influence distribution is unknown. Withheld pivotal rows or more than sixteen necessary resolutions defeat early certification; conservative wide bounds can leave an otherwise decidable case unresolved. This bounded experiment tests enabling feasibility, not deployment readiness or reliable improvement. No new labels/examples are introduced.

lineage.reason: Causal relation, complete comparison/defeat conditions, resource limits, uncertainty and declared preserves fit retained.

decision: No verdict or early-certification feasibility follows from supplied summaries: provisional gain six, one slice losing two with nine flagged labels, and largest apparent gain coinciding with most annotator disagreements. Perform record-level calculation and bounded comparison; report affected slices, every adjudication and unsupported uncertainty without changing thresholds.
